title: AMAZING!!
text: WOW!! This place has the most stunning view of any hotel I have ever stayed at. It is simply an icon and you MUST stay here when visiting Barcelona. The W brand has historically been more of a party brand, however this hotel is managed to keep the fun vibe while moving away from the crazy party and into the refined luxury space, increasing their appeal across many demographics.

title: W is the opposite of winning... Beware
text: This hotel has seen better days. The unusual location was something one could overlook in the past, but now that the quality of everything has devolved, there are definitely better options in Barcelona. The rooms were cold and the heat didn't really work. There was a lack of hot water on 2 of the 4 days.

We are truly sorry to read that your recent experience did not meet the expectations you had based on previous visits.
